aliases_zh: 原发性/继发性自发性气胸
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 脏层胸膜及肺大疱破裂使气体急剧涌入胸膜腔压迫肺脏；若演变为“张力性气胸”或发生于严重基础肺病（COPD、肺大疱、囊性肺病）基础上，纵隔移位阻断腔静脉回流，数分钟至数小时内即可诱发致命性循环呼吸骤停。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 张力性气胸经现场数分钟内粗针穿刺减压及后续胸腔闭式引流可立竿见影挽救生命；行胸腔镜下肺大疱切除与胸膜固定术可治愈并大幅降低复发。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO全球死因不单列气胸；年轻瘦高男性原发性自发性气胸（PSP）经及时救治病死率<1%，但继发性自发性气胸（SSP）及张力性气胸延误救治具有明确急性致死风险。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无全国单列死亡人数；国内队列研究提示合并COPD、肺结核或罕见弥漫性囊性肺病（如BHD综合征、LAM）的继发性气胸及双侧气胸危险度明显升高。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 原发性自发性气胸（PSP）年发病率男性约18–28/10万，女性约1.2–6/10万，吸烟使发病风险提高数倍至二十倍；5年复发率保守治疗可达近半。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 是中国胸外科与呼吸急诊极为常见的急性胸痛呼吸困难急症，年轻瘦高男性剧烈运动/屏气及老年COPD肺大疱患者尤为高发。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 疑诊张力性气胸（极度呼吸困难、患侧呼吸音消失叩诊鼓音、颈静脉怒张、休克低血压、气管移向健侧）切勿等待拍胸片！即刻于患侧锁骨中线第2肋间或腋前/中线第4–5肋间行粗针头穿刺减压放气，随后立即行胸腔闭式引流；非张力性大量气胸立即高浓度吸氧（加速胸腔气体吸收）并行细管/闭式引流；持续漏气、血气胸或复发病例尽早行胸腔镜（VATS）手术修补与胸膜固定。

standard_drugs.name_zh: 医用氧气（高流量吸氧治疗）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 在保守观察或引流期间经氮气洗脱效应将胸膜腔空气吸收速率提高约4倍（慢阻肺高碳酸血症患者需调节滴定）
胸腔穿刺减压及胸腔闭式引流管置入术标准局麻镇痛

non_drug_therapies_zh: 张力性气胸即刻针刺穿刺急救排气
胸腔闭式引流术（水封瓶负压吸引）
电视胸腔镜（VATS）肺大疱切除与机械/滑石粉胸膜固定术（可将5年复发率由约48.5%降至12.1%）
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 单纯胸腔闭式引流住院约3,000–8,000元；行胸腔镜（VATS）微创手术住院约10,000–25,000元

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2023年英国BTS气胸指南突破性支持符合指征的无严重症状患者行门诊便携导管/保守随访治疗，减少住院与创伤；中国队列卫生经济学研究证实，相比单纯引流保守治疗，早期VATS可将5年复发率从48.5%大幅压低至12.1%且具有成本效果（ICER约160,300元/QALY）；年轻患者复发或家族气胸越来越常规筛查FLCN（BHD综合征）基因。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 院前对张力性气胸与急性心梗/肺栓塞的鉴别延迟可致命；年轻反复气胸背后遗传性肺囊性疾病基因诊断普及率仍待提高。

master.definition_en: A malignant tumor arising from the epithelial cells. Microscopically, the neoplastic epithelial cells form cylindrical spatial configurations (cribriform or classic type of adenoid cystic carcinoma), cordlike structures (tubular type of adenoid cystic carcinoma), or solid structures (basaloid variant of adenoid cystic carcinoma). Adenoid cystic carcinomas mostly occur in the salivary glands. Other primary sites of involvement include the lacrimal gland, the larynx, and the lungs. Adenoid cystic carcinomas spread along nerve sheaths, resulting in severe pain, and they tend to recur. Lymph node metastases are unusual; hematogenous tumor spread is characteristic.

curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 罕见头颈涎腺嗜神经肿瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 主要发生于大小唾液腺（腭部小唾液腺、腮腺、颌下腺，偶见泪腺/气管/乳腺）的特殊恶性肿瘤，核心生物学特征是“极端嗜神经生长、生长缓慢但极难切净、极晚期远隔复发”——肿瘤常沿三叉神经或面神经向颅底潜行跳跃性浸润，即使术后5年无恙，10–20年后仍可能出现多发肺转移；气管原发ACC阻塞大气道可致急性窒息。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 早期完整广泛切除联合术后高剂量精准放疗（尤其质子/重离子放疗）可实现较好的局部控制，5年生存率达75%–85%，但10年、15年生存率因极晚期肺/骨转移持续下滑至50%与40%左右；目前对传统化疗及PD-1单抗极度不敏感，尚无获批特效靶向药，肺转移多呈“惰性带瘤长期生存”。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GLOBOCAN未从头颈/涎腺癌中单列ACC；全球年发病率约3–4.5/百万，占所有唾液腺恶性肿瘤约20%–25%，约50%–70%携带MYB-NFIB或MYBL1融合基因
annual_deaths_global.source: Orphanet ORPHA:500062 / WHO Salivary Gland Tumours

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列全国死亡统计；在口腔颌面外科涎腺恶性肿瘤中居第2–3位，以中青年及中老年均可见
annual_deaths_china.source: 《中国口腔颌面部恶性肿瘤诊疗指南》

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 年发病率约0.3–0.45/10万，实性型(Solid pattern)或伴有NOTCH1激活突变者较筛状/管状型侵袭性显著更高（Orphanet ORPHA:500062）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 好发于腭部小唾液腺、腮腺及颌下腺，常以无痛性渐进性肿块伴局部麻木/疼痛就诊

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 气管或主支气管原发腺样囊性癌阻塞主气道致吸气性呼吸困难及窒息先兆：立即吸氧并行急诊支气管镜下肿瘤消融/支架置入畅通气道; 2) 颅底神经侵犯伴剧烈顽固性三叉神经痛或海绵窦受累复视：予普瑞巴林/卡马西平止痛并急诊评估放疗减压。

master.definition_en: Cryoglobulinemia is a type of vasculitis that is caused by abnormal proteins (antibodies) in the blood called 'cryoglobulins.' At cold temperatures, these proteins become solid or gel-like, which can block blood vessels and cause a variety of health problems. Many people affected by this condition will not experience any unusual signs or symptoms. When present, symptoms vary but may include breathing problems; fatigue; glomerulonephritis ; joint or muscle pain; purpura ; Raynaud's phenomenon ; skin death; and/or skin ulcers. In some cases, the exact underlying cause is unknown; however, cryoglobulinemia can be associated with a variety of conditions including certain types of infection; chronic inflammatory diseases (such as autoimmune disease); and/or cancers of the blood or immune system. Treatment varies based on the severity of the condition, the symptoms present in each person and the underlying cause.

master.definition_en: Inflammation of the liver in humans caused by hepatitis delta virus, a defective RNA virus that can only infect hepatitis B patients. For its viral coating, hepatitis delta virus requires the hepatitis B surface antigens produced by these patients. Hepatitis D can occur either concomitantly with (coinfection) or subsequent to (superinfection) hepatitis B infection. Similar to hepatitis B, it is primarily transmitted by parenteral exposure, such as transfusion of contaminated blood or blood products, but can also be transmitted via sexual or intimate personal contact.

master.definition_en: An enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma arising from the small intestine, most commonly the jejunum or ileum. The lymphoma cells are usually medium-sized to large and form an ulcerating mucosal lesion with invasion of the small intestinal wall. Villous atrophy is present in the adjacent small intestinal mucosa. In a minority of cases the lymphoma cells are medium-sized and form a monomorphic infiltrate.
synonyms_en: enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma of small intestine

curated.lethality_detail_zh: α-突触核蛋白在脑内广泛沉积导致认知波动、生动视幻觉、帕金森样僵直及自主神经衰竭（体位性低血压晕厥）；平均病程约5–8年，最大急危陷阱是对传统抗精神病药“极度过敏”，误用一针氟哌啶醇即可在数小时至数日内诱发恶性高热、全身僵直昏迷甚至猝死。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 尚无逆转α-突触核蛋白沉积的根治药物，但路易体痴呆脑内乙酰胆碱缺损比阿尔茨海默病更显著，规范足量使用胆碱酯酶抑制剂（卡巴拉汀、多奈哌齐）往往能大幅改善视幻觉与认知波动；核心在于严格避开传统抗精神病药。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO/GBD并入总痴呆死因统计，诊断后中位生存期约5–8年，吸入性肺炎与跌倒并发症为主因

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 药物过敏与晕厥急救避坑：1) 患者因视幻觉或躁动送急诊时，家属务必主动大声告知医生“患者是路易体痴呆，禁用氟哌啶醇、氯丙嗪、利培酮等强多巴胺阻滞剂”，以防诱发致死性抗精神病药恶性综合征（NMS）；2) 若误用后出现高热、肌强直、意识丧失，立即停药并ICU物理降温、补液及溴隐亭/丹曲林救治；3) 突发体位性低血压晕厥应立即平卧抬高下肢。

standard_drugs.drug_class: 乙酰胆碱酯酶及丁酰胆碱酯酶双抑制剂
standard_drugs.usage_role: 一线核心用药（显著改善注意力波动、视幻觉及妄想，减少抗精神病药需求）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 胶囊约100–250元/月；透皮贴剂约300–500元/月

standard_drugs.name_zh: 喹硫平 / 氯氮平（极小剂量）
standard_drugs.drug_class: 低D2亲和力非典型抗精神病药
standard_drugs.usage_role: 仅在胆碱酯酶抑制剂无效且幻觉威胁安全时极小剂量谨慎使用

non_drug_therapies_zh: 随身携带“路易体痴呆药物禁忌卡”（注明严禁使用氟哌啶醇及胃复安等止吐药）
快速眼动期睡眠行为障碍（RBD，夜间梦中大喊大叫挥拳）应移除床边锐器并垫高护栏防跌落
预防体位性低血压：起床遵循“躺30秒-坐30秒-站30秒”，适当穿弹力袜并增加饮水
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 规范口服胆碱酯酶抑制剂及帕金森对症药物年费约1,500–6,000元人民币

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 脑脊液及皮肤活检α-突触核蛋白种子扩增检测（SAA）已使生前早期精准确诊率突破90%；2) 抗α-突触核蛋白单抗（如Prasinezumab）、靶向β-葡萄糖脑苷脂酶（GBA）及P38 MAPK抑制剂Neflamapimod（2期试验改善步态与认知）正推进中。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 临床漏诊率极高，常被误诊为阿尔茨海默病或帕金森病，导致部分患者在综合医院急诊被误注传统抗精神病药致残致死；2) 中国尚缺乏获批的DLB特异性抗精神病新药（如匹莫范色林）；3) 缺乏阻断α-突触核蛋白病理播散的疾病修饰药物。

master.definition_en: UV-sensitive syndrome is a condition that is characterized by sensitivity to the ultraviolet (UV) rays in sunlight. Even a small amount of sun exposure can cause a sunburn in affected individuals. In addition, these individuals can have freckles, dryness, or changes in coloring (pigmentation) on sun-exposed areas of skin after repeated exposure. Some people with UV-sensitive syndrome have small clusters of enlarged blood vessels just under the skin (telangiectasia), usually on the cheeks and nose. Although UV exposure can cause skin cancers, people with UV-sensitive syndrome do not have an increased risk of developing these forms of cancer compared with the general population.

master.definition_en: A decreased level of serum immunoglobulins. It may be inherited or acquired. It is caused by decreased or inefficient production of immunoglobulins from B cells or by a decrease in the numbers of B cells themselves. Low levels of immunoglobulins will affect the immune system's ability to combat bacterial infection. Supplementation of immunoglobulins is needed to prevent worsening outcomes.

master.definition_en: Hemicrania continua (HC) is a type of primary headache disorder, which means the headache is not caused by another medical condition. Symptoms of HC include constant mild to moderate pain on one side of the head (unilateral) with periods of more intense, severe, migraine -like pain (exacerbations). These severe pain periods can last from 20 minutes to days. The frequency of exacerbations also varies greatly. The headache stays on the same side of the head and usually without pain free periods. HC is more common in women and most often starts in adulthood, but may begin anywhere from 5 to 67 years of age. Diagnosis of hemicrania continua (HC) is made by ruling out other possible causes of the pain and by clinical symptoms. During the periods of severe pain, at least one of the following symptoms must be present on same side of the body as the headache: watering or red eyes (conjunctival injection), congested or runny nose, or drooping eyelid. In addition, the headache pain must respond to treatment with indomethacin. The cause of HC is unknown. Other treatments for those who cannot tolerate long term indomethacin therapy are being studied.

master.definition_en: A rare soft tissue tumor characterized by a compressive mass located in the mediastinum and/or pleura and lung, including prominent lymph node involvement, histologically poorly differentiated and frequently showing rhabdoid features. Loss of SMARCA4 is typically accompanied by SMARCA2-deficiency. Presenting symptoms include dyspnea, cough, chest pain, or dysphagia, among others. The tumors are aggressive with limited response to chemotherapies, rapid local progression, high recurrence rate after surgical resection, and short median survival times. There is a strong association with smoking.

master.definition_en: A rare eyelid malposition disorder characterized by a horizontal fold consisting of redundant skin and underlying pretarsal orbicularis muscle overriding the eyelid margin and causing inward rotation of the eyelashes with potential irritation of the ocular surface. Patients may be asymptomatic or experience foreign body sensation, constant watering, itching, and redness of the eyes. Complications include repeated infections and corneal erosion. The condition is usually bilateral and more commonly affects the lower eyelids.

master.name_en: autosomal recessive ataxia due to PEX16 deficiency
master.definition_en: A rare genetic, peroxisomal disease characterized by chilhood onset progressive spastic paraparesis and ataxia due to PEX 16 deficieny. Additional clinical features include demyelinating and peripheral neuropathies, progressive unsteady gait and limb tremor, dystonia, marked lower limb spasticity, upper limb ataxia, involuntary facial movements, speech disturbance (including cerebellar dysarthria) and cataract. All patients need wheelchair in different periods of their lives depending on the severity of their condition. Cognitive functions are mostly preserved (slow deterioration over time were observed in few cases).

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

master.definition_en: A stroke disorder caused by obstruction of blood flow to the brain, due to thrombotic (local blood clot formation) or embolic (due to a blood clot or other material traveling from another site) event.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 脑血管急性动脉血栓或心源性栓子阻塞脑动脉，每延迟1分钟约190万个神经元死亡；大血管闭塞（如颈内动脉末端或大脑中动脉M1段）可在数小时至数天内进展为恶性脑水肿、脑疝或中枢性呼吸循环衰竭致命；全球每年致死约359万人，占全部卒中死亡约49.5%，且为成人致残首要病因。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 发病4.5小时内静脉溶栓及6–24小时内（结合影像灌注筛选）血管内机械取栓可显著逆转神经功能缺损；但受限于严格时间窗与神经元不可再生性，大量患者仍遗留偏瘫、失语等长期残疾，需长期二级预防与康复。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021《Lancet Neurology》全球缺血性卒中年死亡约359万例（占全部卒中730万死亡的49.5%）

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: GBD 2021报告中国全部脑卒中（含缺血性与出血性）年死亡总计约260万例；《中国心血管健康与疾病报告2024》显示中国城乡脑血管病粗死亡率分别达175.58/10万（农村）与140.02/10万（城市），缺血性卒中约占全部新发卒中的65%以上
annual_deaths_china.source: IHME GBD 2021 China Stroke (PMC12537097) / 中国心血管健康与疾病报告2024

epidemiology.prevalence_global: GBD 2021全球全类型卒中现患约 9,380 万例、年新发约 1,190 万例，其中缺血性卒中占新发卒中的 65.3%
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国全类型卒中现患逾 2,630 万例（GBD 2021），年新发逾 410 万例（成人粗发病率约 491.0 / 10万人），居中国居民死因及致残负担前列

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: ‘FAST’识别即刻呼叫急救并直送卒中中心，入院25分钟内完成头颅平扫CT排除脑出血：1）发病4.5小时内（部分经多模影像筛选可延至24小时）无禁忌证立即静脉溶栓（阿替普酶0.9mg/kg或替奈普酶0.25mg/kg单次静推）；2）大血管闭塞（LVO）在6小时内或6–24小时存在可挽救半暗带者立即行急诊血管内机械取栓；3）急性非心源性轻型卒中/高危TIA予21天短期双抗（阿司匹林+氯吡格雷），心源性（房颤）卒中视梗死面积在1–14天启动抗凝。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2024–2025年中国牵头及参与的多项重磅试验改写国际指南：国产与进口替奈普酶（如ORIGINAL、TRACE-2等试验）以单次静脉推注实现不劣于阿替普酶的再通获益且操作大幅提速，已获批AIS适应症并获中国指南I级A类推荐；同时超时间窗溶栓（如4.5–24h基于灌注影像）和大核心梗死（large core）血管内取栓3期试验（ANGEL-ASPECT等）成功拓宽了危重脑梗死救治人群。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1）公众对卒中急救黄金时间窗识别率仍不足，高比例患者错过4.5h溶栓；2）大血管再通后存在‘无效再通’及缺乏高循证神经保护剂；3）卒中后偏瘫失语长期康复与护理负担沉重。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。
